paper.title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
paper.central_claim: Failure-driven evolutionary discovery of reusable skill folders improves fixed-model agent test accuracy and transfers zero-shot beyond source benchmark.

provenance.notes: sonnet slot configured as gpt-6.1-sol per dispatch; independently verifiable model receipt/session ID unavailable, no probe.

sections_read: Appendix A both skill documents and complete economic analysis script

evidence.quote: The underlying model remains frozen throughout; only the skill repository and agent metadata evolve across iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: Non-weight persisted update object; in-scope A loop.

evidence.quote: Analyzes the Executor’s output traces, predicted answers, and ground-truth answers to diagnose failures and propose high-level skill descriptions.
evidence.support_explanation: Supervised diagnosis uses labels on training set, not autonomous label-free discovery.

evidence.quote: This serves two purposes: it prevents redundant proposals, and it enables the Proposer to refine what previously partially worked and avoid making the same mistakes making its context progressively richer across iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: Cumulative history is context, not an experimentally certified edited improver.

signatures.object: Branch-versioned SKILL.md instruction/helper-script library plus metadata
signatures.information: Training failures, traces, predicted/reference answers and prior proposal outcomes
signatures.operation: Propose new/edit skill; builder materializes folder; validation score selects top-k branches; optional merge unique skills across runs
signatures.output: Persisted frozen-model agent program with reusable skills
signatures.conditions: Trustworthy task scorer; train/test isolated; metadata triggers activate intended skill
signatures.feedback: Supervised answer scoring and raw execution failure traces
signatures.selection_rule: Scalar top-k validation score; default capacity3; not explicit Pareto nondominance
signatures.selection_data: Train diagnosis, disjoint selection validation; remaining final test
signatures.persistence: Git branches/config/skill folders; failed branches deleted; feedback history retained
signatures.later_use: Best program runs unseen tests; SealQA skill transferred unchanged to BrowseComp
signatures.claimed_effect: Accuracy and portable capabilities without weight updates
signatures.failure_boundary: No equal-budget prompt-only/history-off/frontier-off controls; single run; merge split safety unclear

claims.text: Evolved skills improve OfficeQA/SealQA held-out performance.
claims.setting: Claude Code Opus4.5;1.5 evolution epochs;OfficeQA train12/24/36,validation17;SealQA111 total,10%train
claims.baseline_control: Same no-skill model; no matched alternative improver
claims.selection_vs_test: Train/validation/test disjoint stated; varying train sizes change remaining test; merged union audit absent
claims.result: OfficeQA60.6→63.4/65.8/64.5; merged prose67.9 vs Table1 68.1. SealQA26.6→38.7 (+12.1pp).
claims.denominator: OfficeQA246 minus train+17; merged exact common test n unresolved. SealQA remaining after train/validation, exact n unstated.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Reported later-use package benefit; exact merged OfficeQA result unresolved; no skill-unit superiority.

claims.text: Unmodified skill transfers beyond evolution benchmark.
claims.selection_vs_test: No target modification or target-driven optimization reported
claims.allowed_conclusion: Limited direct retained transfer; no broad cross-model or improver-level certification.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported frozen-agent test gains plus unmodified search-skill transfer on128 external examples; no improver-level experiment.

G.reason: Specific automated skill-authoring gap, but broad claim prompt/code units cannot transfer lacks independent support; direct Feedback Descent lineage.

M.reason: Diagnosis, reusable folder synthesis, external score and transfer coherently address gap; packaging advantage unisolated.

X.reason: Full prompts, branch lineage, scorer and gate reconstruct lifecycle; appendix parent-selection contradiction and merge details unresolved.

E.measurement.reason: Answer correctness relevant with numeric normalization; substring false positives and unaudited judge; merged exact score contradicts table.

E.causality.reason: Same frozen no-skill executor vs retained package tests joint effect, not format, history, archive or equal-budget alternative improver.

E.holdout.reason: Disjoint train/selection/final-test stated and unmodified external128-example transfer; merged cross-run split safety not shown. Selection validation never counted as independent holdout.

E.statistics.reason: Sample sizes and nonmonotonic training-size results reported; single run, no intervals, significance or uncertainty.

E.cost.reason: No measured evolution/serving tokens/calls/time/dollars; epochs and cost excuse not accounting.
